QuestInfo.name: [Azwan] Alliance Mission Complete
QuestInfo.0: You find out the truth behind the elixir. Gardin will take over the investigation from here. Talk to #bGardin#k at the #bAzwan Obelisk#k.
QuestInfo.1: Gardin said they will take care the situation around Ariant and learn what they can now that Azwan is open. He tells you to talk to #bNeinheart#k in #bEreve#k.
QuestInfo.2: You told Neinheart what happened. He thanked you and said to rest easy, as the Alliance's intelligence arms will take on the case. If you find information related to the Black Mage during your training or adventure, relay it to the Alliance.

0.0: Thanks for your help out here. If it weren't for you, who knows what would have happened. I gotta say though, I finally get what all the hubbub is about you around the Alliance.
0.1: Anyway, we can call that mission complete for now. We'll stay here and keep an eye on things. It's possible there is more to learn in Azwan as well.
0.2: You should go to Ereve and report to Neinheart.\r\n#b#e(If you accept, you'll travel to Ereve.)

yes.0: Thanks again. Good luck out there.

no.0: Believe you me, if it were up to me, you'd stick right here solving all our problems. Haha. Just kidding, it'd be a waste to keep you tied up here.

1.0: Welcome. It seems your mission was fruitful. Tell me everything that happened, and leave no detail unsaid.

yes.0: ...I see. So, Hilla is active in Maple World. We'd considered that possibility, but hoped that wasn't yet the case.
yes.1: Regardless, it was thanks to you we have this forewarning. Good work.
yes.2: Our intelligence agents will investigate for the time being. Take this chance to train, or adventure, or whatever you'd like, really. Though, if you obtain #binformation pertaining to the Black Mage, relay it to the Alliance#k immediately.

npc.0: You should go to Ereve and report to Neinheart.
